name: Donecle
summary: Autonomous drone inspections with machine-learning defect detection that finds lightning strikes, dents and paint wear and produces a report.
paragraphs: Autonomous drone inspections with machine-learning defect detection that finds lightning strikes, dents and paint wear and produces a report.
whyItMatters: JetBlue began deploying it in April 2026 for lightning-strike and hail checks, which normally keep an aircraft on the ground for hours.
